profile.name: Yash Thakkar
profile.tagline: Designing trend-forward collections that earn their shelf space, from first sketch to final garment.
profile.bio: An adept and NIFT-accredited fashion designer with a strong foundation in fashion, merchandising and sourcing. Known for conceptualising and delivering innovative, trend-forward designs that align seamlessly with brand identity and customer expectations. Skilled in sketch development, fabric and trim selection, sourcing, fittings and final garment. Brings a forward-thinking approach to fashion design, merging creativity with commercial viability to produce compelling, market-relevant collections.

experience.summary: Owning the end-to-end design lifecycle for two denim brands across menswear and womenswear, aligning every collection with brand identity, global trends and regional market preferences.
highlights: Proactively managed and owned the end-to-end design lifecycle for two denim brands across menswear and womenswear, aligning collections with brand identity, global trends and regional market preferences.
Conceptualise seasonal collections, trend boards and range plans, translating trend research (WGSN, catwalks, street style, Edited) into commercially viable, fashion-forward ranges.
Collaborate closely with Buying, Merchandising and Production teams to execute creative vision and deliver commercially successful product on time.
Manage the design process end-to-end: track critical path timelines and prepare tech packs, CADs and fabric-trim sheets for supplier meetings and bulk production.
Analyse sell-through data and customer feedback with Buying and Merchandising to inform future design decisions.
points: Owns two denim brands, menswear and womenswear
Trend boards, range plans and tech packs
Works with Buying, Merchandising and Production

experience.summary: Designed across women's, men's and kids' categories from concept to launch, including the brand's highest-selling licensed and graphic collections.
highlights: Coordinated with cross-functional and creative teams to develop fashion products across women's, men's and kids' categories, from concept through to launch.
Interfaced with pattern makers and manufacturing teams to execute successful, quality-compliant product launches.
Managed a team of two junior designers and mentored interns and college students on final-year design projects.
Illustrated graphics for licensed properties (Pink Panther, Popeye, Marvel, DC); designed the highest-selling Truck Art and Stranger Things collections.
points: Women’s, men’s and kids’ ranges, concept to launch
Best-selling Truck Art and Stranger Things collections
Led two junior designers and mentored interns

experience.summary: Spearheaded end-to-end design and development for men's and women's clothing, from original flat sketches through to tech packs.
highlights: Spearheaded end-to-end design and development for men's and women's clothing, from original flat sketches through to tech packs.
Conducted global trend research and competitive analysis to inform seasonal lines presented to senior leadership.
Sourced and evaluated fabrics and trims with vendors and mills, collaborating with Buying, Merchandising and Product Development on print, fabric and trim selections.
points: Men’s and women’s clothing, sketch to tech pack
Fabric and trim sourcing with mills

experience.summary: Supported the buying and planning process, aligning design concepts with assortment strategies, sales goals and market demand.
highlights: Supported the buying and planning process, aligning design concepts with assortment strategies, sales goals and market demand.
Researched contemporary fashion and graphic trends, translating insights into on-brand, trend-forward applications.
Led fabric sourcing and tech pack creation; regularly presented style and fit proposals to senior leadership.
